objective: A Postgres outage must degrade a verdict, not fail it. When the persona cache's get or set raises psycopg.OperationalError, /api/verdict/* still returns 200 with a fresh narration (cached=false) and logs one warning per failed call. Illustrative example: issue 999 is not a real issue.
contract:
apps/api/src/api/persona/cache.py -- NarrationCacheStore protocol (unchanged):
    def get(self, key: CacheKey) -> CachedNarration | None: ...
    def set(self, key: CacheKey, narration: CachedNarration) -> None: ...
NarrationOut.cached: bool (unchanged).
negative: No change to NarrationCacheStore's signature, the cache SQL, PROMPT_VERSION or NarrationOut.
Nothing outside apps/api/. packages/cfb-engine and apps/web belong to other agents.
Don't add retries or a circuit breaker: fail open on each call, nothing more.
rubric: Written first and seen failing: tests/test_persona_cache_outage.py -- get raising, set raising, both raising; each asserts HTTP 200, cached=false, and a warning logged.
Sabotage: re-raise in the get wrapper -> the get tests go red; restore byte-exact.
